title: Cellset cache, coalescer and Arrow cache are per user on pass-through datasources, and unresolvable roles bypass the caches

criteria.given: two callers with the SAME Saiku role set query the same cube on a security.type=passthrough datasource
criteria.then: the cellset cache key (QueryCacheKey), the in-flight coalescer key (QueryCoalescer) and the Arrow result cache are all keyed per caller identity: ThinQueryService mixes a per-caller identity fragment (from a QueryCacheIdentityContext seam implemented by SecurityAwareConnectionManager, reusing the saiku#2326 visibility rule) into the cache key, so the second caller neither reuses the first caller's cached cellset nor coalesces onto their in-flight execution

criteria.given: a datasource that is NOT pass-through (no security, or one2one/lookup role masking)
criteria.then: the identity fragment is omitted and the key stays byte-identical to the role-keyed key — cache hit rates are unchanged

criteria.given: a failure while resolving the caller's roles or identity (userService or the seam throws, key build fails)
criteria.then: the caches are bypassed fail-closed: currentRolesForCacheKey no longer swallows exceptions into a shared role-less key, cacheKeyFor returns null, executeCached executes live, and the coalescer pass-throughs

regression tests ship for per-identity keys on pass-through, unchanged role-keyed behaviour elsewhere, and fail-closed bypass on unresolvable roles; every ThinQueryService that consults the shared caches (session bean, eval bean, off-request reader and CSV producer) is wired with the identity seam
